QuestInfo.name: The Knights' Path
QuestInfo.1: Empress #p110100# is worried about rumors that the Cygnus Knights have betrayed Maple World. Go to the Temple of Time to discover the origin of this rumor. An agent of the Cygnus Knights has been sent ahead, and is waiting for you.
QuestInfo.2: You met #p1103006# in the #m270000100#. Ask her what she's found out.

0.0: I'm sorry. I don't mean to worry you, too! I should be doing something about this, instead of moping here.
0.1: What I want to know is, why do people think we're traitors? I'd like you to investigate this rumor.
0.2: I've already dispatched an agent to the Temple of Time. Please meet with #p1103006# and ask her what she's uncovered. Once I know the source of this rumor, I can decide upon the future course of the Cygnus Knights.
0.3: Thank you. Please, be careful.\r\n\r\n#e(You will be moved to #m270000100# after you accept.)#n

no.0: Am I asking too much of you...?

1.0: Y-you're #h0#, right? H-h-here for my report? Thank goodness you're here! I th-th-thought one of those freaky monks was g-going to get me.

yes.0: The m-monsters here are way too strong for us C-Cygnus Knights. Luckily, I'm real good at hiding, s-so I was able to get in. But it's scary in there!

npc.0: #p1103006# should be waiting for you in the #m270000100#. Please find out what she's learned.
